svg.title: DETER: suppression during pretraining
svg.desc: During pretraining, one model theta is updated at every step. At all other steps, a pretraining step: the gradient of the next-token loss on the filtered data goes into its gradient statistics s, and theta takes a descent step. Every P steps, a suppression step: the gradient of the same loss on the removed target-domain documents goes into its own gradient statistics s_F, and theta takes an ascent step. After release, an adversary fine-tunes on target-domain data: with filtering alone or post-hoc unlearning the model reaches the loss of an unfiltered model after little fine-tuning; with suppression during pretraining it takes much longer.
